review_kind: Phase 0 independent design skeptic, candidate ADR-0148 v1

findings.location: ADR-0148 Decision point 1 vs trust.py:1028, 5182; ledger at production/ledger.py:826,1360
findings.claim: DP1's 'same ChainLedger-backed lifecycle ledger ADR-0147 made durable' names a mechanism absent from trust.py and unplaceable there.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct grep: trust.py contains 0 occurrences of ChainLedger/JsonlLedger/fcntl; dskit/pipeline imports nothing from dskit.production. Broker state is plain per-instance dicts.
findings.compounding: stream_id = _digest({producer, root, purpose}) (trust.py:1173-1180); DP1 placed consumer_run_identity inside producer.run_identity, so stream_id is NOT a pure function of derivation_intent_sha256 and a retry under a fresh consumer session mints a SECOND root for one intent -- the exact effect F3-I01 forbids.
findings.author_verification_2: CONFIRMED by direct read of produce().
findings.family: unbuildable durability claim; unsound identity function
findings.disposition: candidate stopped; DP1 to be rebuilt

findings.location: ADR-0148 Decision point 5 vs trust.py:1624-1679 (_consume_binding), 1939-1949 (_stream_for_run_identity), 709 (single scalar _stream_id)
findings.claim: A V2 multiport CapturedBindings can never be fully consumed: require(a) appends terminal CONSUMED and adds the whole stream to _consumed_streams, so require(b) is refused twice over.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct read: _consume_binding gates on 'stream_id in self._consumed_streams' and _require_head(stream_id,'CAPTURED'), then unconditionally appends CONSUMED and does _consumed_streams.add(stream_id). Per-input tracking exists only as _used_inputs, which does not gate.
findings.compounding: CapturedBindings.__init__ carries ONE scalar _stream_id while hop 3 requires ports from TWO streams; _stream_for_run_identity refuses one run_identity spanning two stream_ids.
findings.family: false compatibility claim ('no change needed') over provably incompatible code
findings.disposition: candidate stopped; DP5 to be rebuilt on a multi-capture-capable primitive

findings.location: ADR-0148 DP5 cites trust.py:4991 as the consumer-input declaration
findings.claim: trust.py:4991 is one row of _P4_BATCH_USES, a signing-usage table; the real declaration is document.py:766 _REPLAY_TAPE_INPUTS = ('tape_manifest','tape_data'), enforced by _replay_node_errors at parse.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct read of both sites.

findings.claim: 'bind_captured' does not exist anywhere in the codebase; the real method is captured_bindings (trust.py:1532).
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED: grep for 'def bind_captured' returns nothing; 'def captured_bindings' at 1532.

findings.claim: DP4 addresses one of at least eight independently hardcoded v1-schema literal sites; _SyntheticRawPreflight._parse_member (7447) hard-checks the closed SIX-key v1 shape per member and would refuse every v2 member.
findings.author_verification: Not independently re-verified site-by-site by the author; accepted pending the v2 Phase 0 enumeration.
findings.disposition: enumerate exhaustively; one shared versioned shape-owner, not eight copies

findings.location: ADR-0148 hop-1 narrative vs bundles.py:897-911 and the pipeline/production layering rule
findings.claim: Hop 1's envelope-writing algorithm has no named owner module; any placement either duplicates bundles.py's shape logic or inverts layering.
findings.author_verification: Accepted: the ADR genuinely names no owner for this step.
findings.disposition: name the owner; strategy passed INTO trust, never a trust->production import

findings.claim: 'chronologically after by construction, not a skippable check' overclaims: _authorization checks the roster digests for sha256 SHAPE only, never against a live published roster.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED by direct read: the three roster digests pass through cls._hash(...) only.
findings.disposition: name the function performing the live cross-check, or narrow the claim

findings.claim: The sole entry point is a bare file path; forecast_bundle.py already holds ~850 lines of unrelated Gate-4/ADR-0114 capital code whose fixtures use deployment_eligible: true. No new symbol is named.
findings.author_verification: CONFIRMED: file's __all__ is BUNDLE_UNIT, DEFAULT_REFERENCE, ForecastBundle, ConfirmedCaps, KNOWN_AT_FIELDS, LABEL_CONTRACT_FIELDS, ZERO_DRIFT, default_label_contract, gross_return -- nothing captured-binding related.
findings.disposition: name the new symbol; disclaim coupling to ForecastBundle/ConfirmedCaps

findings.claim: tzdata_version_sha256 is added to the v2 scope with no described consumer; inert as written.
findings.disposition: wire a check or drop the pin claim

findings.claim: docs/plans/closeout-2026-09-14/02-shared-foundations.md still carries the same bundles.py CapturedBindings mis-citation.
open_capture is at 1461 (ADR said ~1464); captured_bindings at 1532 (ADR said ~1540).
